name: Perplexity Computer and Projects
customer: Individuals and teams doing research, files and continuing project work.
status: Computer/Projects available; Brain packaging and rollout should be verified per plan. Portable Computer currently available on supported Windows/Linux hardware.
summary: Computer combines persistent project files, connected sources and memory; Portable Computer adds local inference with approved cloud escalation.
strength: Research distribution and a packaged local/cloud agent stack make it a close comparator.
opportunity: Test accepted-output continuity after source change, interruption and multi-user correction; generic projects or local/cloud routing are established alternatives.
pricing: Fetched pricing renders individual $17 Pro/$167 Max per month billed annually despite enterprise URL; Max shows 10,000 monthly credits. Enterprise Academy documents 500/15,000 seat credits and organization pools. Do not infer enterprise seat dollars from individual render.

projectWork.note: Shared persistent project files and connected context; individual task accountability and acceptance mechanics require hands-on comparison.

artifactReview.note: Artifacts and continuing work shown; independent exact-revision quality acceptance contract not established in fetched pages.

memoryEvidence.note: Project Brain accumulates context; source permission rechecks and claim dependency granularity remain questions.

durability.note: Enterprise tasks pause at credit exhaustion, retain progress and resume after funding. Crash/effect uncertainty guarantees not established.

costControls.note: Seat allocations, shared pool, member/group limits and optional refill ceilings; different unit from Simon dollar ledger.

deployment.note: Cloud plus local harness/inference on supported Windows/Linux devices; hardware floor includes 24GB GPU memory and supported hardware. Cloud escalation asks approval.

name: Dust
customer: Teams combining company knowledge, agent conversations and shared tasks.
status: Available; client-side MCP separately labeled preview in documentation.
summary: Pods share tasks, files and conversations among humans and agents, with reusable skills and generated interactive Frames.
strength: Matches Simon's shared human/agent project premise closely.
opportunity: Compare evolving brief, current evidence, immutable accepted outputs and repair lifecycle; a shared board is not a novel claim.
pricing: Fetched locale EUR: Free 500 lifetime credits; Pro €30 monthly/€24 annual, 8,000 credits/seat/month; Max €150/€120,40,000 credits. API line separately $0.01/credit; tax excluded. Enabled overages can be capped; in-flight responses may complete beyond quota.

projectWork.note: Humans and agents can create, assign, work on and complete shared tasks; externally synced tasks require explicit authority to avoid loops.

artifactReview.note: Frames preview/export/share interactive files. Scheduled regeneration overwrites current file; immutable quality approval semantics not established.

memoryEvidence.note: Shared Pod files/conversations become context; restricted membership/editor roles exist. Revoked-source derivative memory behavior not established.

durability.note: Scheduled work and saved linked conversations exist; crash-safe external effects and unknown-charge reservations not established.

costControls.note: Per-seat credits, capped optional overages and programmatic tracking; completed in-flight response can exceed quota.

deployment.note: Managed SaaS; pricing lists US/EU residency and enterprise single-tenant options. Whole-platform self-hosting not established.

name: Glean Agents
customer: Organizations with connected enterprise knowledge and shared operational workflows.
status: Auto/workflow agents available; independent agents explicitly beta and deployment dependent.
summary: Knowledge-connected agents support configured workflows, delegation and independently attributed shared operations.
strength: Enterprise retrieval, identity and existing workflow distribution.
opportunity: Benchmark scoped memory after revocation and quality acceptance after changing requirements, rather than assuming citations or service identities are unique.
pricing: Seat/agent commercial dollars not established from fetched documentation; obtain a comparable quote including deployment, usage and support.

projectWork.note: Workflow branches/tools and dynamic delegated research; independent profiles/channels in beta.

artifactReview.note: Agent publishing/write controls described; output-file exact-revision quality acceptance not established.

memoryEvidence.note: Workflow working memory and scoped knowledge; persistent procedures should receive human approval.

durability.note: Independent agents monitor events and continue shared workflows without an individual session; deployment dependent beta. External uncertain-effect semantics unknown.

costControls.note: Token context tuning documented; project monetary caps, unresolved-charge accounting and commercial units not established.

deployment.note: Managed enterprise deployment with administrator scoped service credentials; independent capabilities depend on deployment.

name: Hebbia
customer: Financial, legal and corporate research teams handling document-intensive analysis.
status: Available; June 2026 shipped update describes cited PowerPoint and Tick-and-Tie checks.
summary: Projects/Matrix research with source-grounded slides, metric verification, API and MCP.
strength: Direct counterexample to generic source-linked deliverables and AI figure checking.
opportunity: Evaluate non-financial production bundles, requirement change impact and measured review effort against strong specialist checks.
pricing: No public commercial dollars established from fetched pages; quote required.

projectWork.note: Shared projects, history and publish/unpublish controls.

artifactReview.note: Generated PowerPoint source markers and Tick-and-Tie agent matching presentation figures to reference data. Version-bound human acceptance not established.

memoryEvidence.note: Inline citations across output and API/MCP; optional pre-run source review.

durability.note: Project history documented; fault/retry or uncertain external effect semantics not established.

costControls.note: Budget controls and prices not established from fetched update.

deployment.note: Hosted product plus API/MCP integration; whole-product local deployment not established.

name: Gemini Notebook formerly NotebookLM
customer: Individuals, educators and teams creating source-grounded briefings and presentations.
status: Current official help now uses Gemini Notebook; availability and plan-dependent quotas apply.
summary: Source-grounded notebooks with generated reports, media and slide decks.
strength: Low-friction source synthesis and existing Google distribution.
opportunity: Changing-source handling is already documented; test whether previously produced outputs become stale and revisions preserve evidence.
pricing: Free and higher bundled plan limits documented; specific current commercial dollars not established from fetched help. Compare full bundle costs and actual task quotas.

projectWork.note: Shared source notebooks and generated outputs; an accountable human/agent production board not established.

artifactReview.note: Slide presentation, PDF/PPTX download and slide revisions documented. Official help says revisions currently do not consider sources; native-object editability has not been validated.

memoryEvidence.note: Source citations; Drive imports automatically sync and become inaccessible when Drive access is lost. Existing derivatives' treatment remains a separate question.

durability.note: Background generation and previous decks documented; durable multi-tool work and interruption reconciliation not established.

costControls.note: Plan-based usage/source/deck limits; project hard dollar budgets not established.

deployment.note: Managed web/mobile Google service. Private/local execution not established.
